description:
Returns the complete public holiday list for a year — nationwide or for one of the 16 German federal states including state-specific holidays (Stand 2026-08-15). Suited to the question which holidays fall in a year in a specific state. Working days between dates are counted by werktage_berechnen. Key output fields: datum (ISO), name (German), bundesweit (boolean).

Example user questions: "Welche Feiertage gibt es 2026 in Bayern?"; "Feiertage in Berlin auflisten"; "Welche gesetzlichen Feiertage hat Sachsen?"; "Gibt es im Oktober 2026 Feiertage in NRW?"

land.description: 2-letter federal state code. Omit for nationwide-only holidays.
